targetPassage.text: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment. You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed; but You remain the same, and Your years will never end.”

sourcePassage.text: He makes the winds His messengers, flames of fire His servants.

targetPassage.text: Now about the angels He says: “He makes His angels winds, His servants flames of fire.”

sourcePassage.text: May his days be few; may another take his position.

targetPassage.text: “For it is written in the book of Psalms: ‘May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it,’ and, ‘May another take his position.’

sourcePassage.text: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.

targetPassage.text: As it is written: “He has scattered abroad His gifts to the poor; His righteousness endures forever.”

sourcePassage.text: I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”

targetPassage.text: And in keeping with what is written, “I believed, therefore I have spoken,” we who have the same spirit of faith also believe and therefore speak,

sourcePassage.text: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!

targetPassage.text: And again: “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and extol Him, all you peoples.”

sourcePassage.text: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

targetPassage.text: So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”

sourcePassage.text: The LORD swore an oath to David, a promise He will not revoke: “One of your descendants I will place on your throne.

targetPassage.text: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that He would place one of his descendants on his throne.

sourcePassage.text: Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.

targetPassage.text: “Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.” “The venom of vipers is on their lips.”
